title: Add a repeatable anonymous test of the public production surface (robots, sitemap, llms.txt, status API, redirects, 404s, head tags)

verify.cmd: pnpm exec vitest run test/e2e/public-surface.test.ts && pnpm exec playwright test --list public-surface
verify.note: Offline half: the parsers that judge robots/sitemap/head tags/JSON-LD pass their unit tests. The live half (PW_BASE_URL + PW_SITE_URLS) is collected by Playwright and run against production by whoever has network; it is not asserted here.

detail: An earlier audit was source-and-metadata only: no production API probe, crawler or indexing behaviour was exercised. This adds test/e2e/public-surface.spec.ts (request-only, anonymous, read-only GETs) covering robots.txt, sitemap.xml vs robots rules, llms.txt and llms-full.txt (banned weekly-promise copy), /api/status, anonymous private-API error behaviour, the /themes/midnight to /themes/nocturne 308s, real 404s with noindex, canonical/title/og/JSON-LD on key pages, www to apex, and per-site robots, sitemap, canonical host, no Set-Cookie on ISR renders and deep 404s. Findings: /mnt/project-files/audits/functional-qa-2026-10-28/public-surface.md.
